harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: 52 requests of probe.py 34 (thirteenth build), all kind raw, six grids (1, 8, 9, 12 and 16 warps per SM, and 2 CTAs of 9 warps per SM), 40 repetitions: A HOLD THAT STANDS BETWEEN A PRODUCER AND ITS FIXED-LATENCY READER, with the yield flag and without - "via": "hold": the producer at stall count 1 without the yield flag, then ONE word that sets no barrier, waits none and writes a register nobody reads, at stall count d - 1, then the reader, d cycles behind the producer. (1) Seven pairs, four requests each, 2 ... 8 cycles: v_<x>_f = the distance made of one-cycle fillers ("via": "fill", the reference); v_<x>_h = made by ONE hold without the flag; v_<x>_y = by ONE hold THAT CARRIES THE YIELD FLAG; v_<x>_c = the control: the producer's word stands behind the reader and its checksum, a filler in its place, and the model gives the reader the new content (2 and 7 cycles: it must not be right), with the flagged hold in its place. The pairs and their holds: `SHF -> PRMT.r3`, `IADD3 -> LEA.r1`, `IADD3 -> LEA.r2` and `MOV -> QMMA.r1` with `MOV` as the hold, `LEA -> IMAD.r3` with `LOP3.LUT`, `IMAD -> PRMT.r1` with `SHF.R.U32.HI`, `ISETP -> ISETP.p` with `SEL`. (2) Nine other words as the hold of `IMAD -> PRMT.r1`, 3 ... 6 cycles, w_imad_prmt1_<hold>_h without the flag and _y with it: `IADD3`, `MOV`, `LOP3.LUT`, `SEL`, `PRMT`, `LEA`, `ISETP`, `VOTEU`, `UMOV`. (3) The hold at a fixed stall count and the producer holding the rest ("hstall"), _h | _y: x_lea_imad3_lop33 (`LEA`, `LOP3.LUT` at stall count 3, the reader `IMAD`; 4 ... 8 cycles), x_mov_q1_mov3 (`MOV`, `MOV` at 3, the tensor word; 4 ... 10), x_mov_q1_mov7 (`MOV`, `MOV` at 7, the tensor word; 8 ... 13). Fronts: no word in front, and fifteen `STS.128` at stall 4 in front (for the pairs into a tensor word: no word in front, and one tensor word of the same form on another accumulator at stall 7 in front)

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
conditions.card_state: a Server Edition card (this model takes no clock offset); the probe alone, no power limit
